title: The Green Lake Mystery
intro: This quiz follows two curious kids and Grandma June as they discover what algae are and why algal blooms happen.

choices: Tiny organisms that grow in water
Large animals that live on land
Rocks found at the bottom of lakes
Plants that only grow in deserts
questions.explanation: Algae are tiny organisms that grow in water.

questions.prompt: What do algae use to make their own food?
choices: Sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide
Soil, insects, and rocks
Fish, oxygen, and sand
Rain, wind, and fertilizer only
questions.explanation: Algae use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make their own food.

choices: When all algae disappear
When algae grow much faster than normal
When flowers grow around a lake
When lake water freezes
questions.explanation: An algal bloom happens when algae grow much faster than normal.

questions.prompt: Why can algal blooms harm fish?
choices: They make the water too cold
They remove all the plants from the shore
They can reduce oxygen in the water
They make fish grow too quickly
questions.explanation: Algal blooms can harm fish because they can reduce oxygen in the water.

questions.prompt: How can people help prevent algal blooms?
choices: Use more fertilizer near lakes
Add phosphate directly to the water
Keep fertilizer away from waterways and use less phosphate
Remove all algae from every lake
questions.explanation: People can help prevent algal blooms by keeping fertilizer away from waterways and using less phosphate.
